'''Laksak''' is a Federation system in the Core Systems, reached by Commanders pursuing '''[[Lei Cheung]]'''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s shield and sensor Engineering after a referral from [[The Dweller]]. It hosts '''[[Trader's Rest]]''', Lei Cheung's workshop.<ref name="inara-laksak">[https://inara.cz/elite/starsystem/4169/ Laksak — Star System], Inara.</ref>

== Overview ==

* '''Star:''' Class F (scoopable)
* '''Allegiance:''' Federation
* '''Government:''' Democracy
* '''Security:''' High
* '''Economy:''' Agriculture / Refinery<ref name="inara-laksak" />

Unlike most of the systems in this branch of the Engineer network, Laksak is Federation territory rather than independent — worth knowing if you're tracking Federation reputation or superpower-aligned missions while you're there.

== Engineer Facility ==

'''[[Trader's Rest]]''' is a surface Engineer base on Laksak A 1, operated by '''[[Lei Cheung]]'''.<ref name="inara-traders-rest">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/52146/ Trader's Rest in Laksak — Station], Inara.</ref>

No system permit is required to enter Laksak. See [[Lei Cheung]] for the full discovery, invitation, and unlock requirements for his workshop.
